tools.description: Audit a domain's email authentication DNS: SPF (record count, all qualifier, includes, ~DNS lookups vs 10 limit), DMARC (p, sp, pct, rua/ruf, adkim/aspf), DKIM (common or given selectors, key type and length), MX, plus BIMI / MTA-STS / TLS-RPT presence. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_auth_check · Private data: domain_auth_check · Public sink: domain_auth_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_auth_check · Private data: domain_auth_check · Public sink: domain_auth_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
